title: Distribution of maximal path prefixes
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $0\le k\le n$. Choose a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ uniformly at random, and take its maximal path prefix at level $k$. The resulting probability mass function is the distribution of that prefix as a finite subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is a level from $0$ through $n$, inclusive
caveat: The definition of maximal path prefix is not included, so its precise meaning cannot be stated here.
